summary: Tested Stripe Elements payment method flow implementation. Backend: All 8/8 tests PASSED for new /api/create-setup-intent and /api/confirm-setup-intent endpoints. Frontend: Payment Method Dialog with Stripe CardElement renders correctly, opens/closes properly, all form elements present. No runtime errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe Elements payment method flow is fully implemented and working. Backend SetupIntent endpoints return valid Stripe client_secret and customer_id. Frontend PaymentMethodDialog opens from Subscription page via 'Add Card' button when no payment method exists or 'Change Card' button when one exists. Dialog contains: cardholder name input (data-testid='cardholder-name-input'), Stripe CardElement wrapper (data-testid='card-element-wrapper'), security notice, Cancel (data-testid='cancel-card-btn') and Save (data-testid='save-card-btn') buttons. Translation keys work for EN/ES/FR.

backend_create_setup_intent.details: POST /api/create-setup-intent returns client_secret (starts with 'seti_') and customer_id (starts with 'cus_')

backend_confirm_setup_intent.details: POST /api/confirm-setup-intent requires payment_method_id, returns 422 without it, returns 5xx with invalid payment method

backend_auth_required.details: Both endpoints correctly require authentication (return 401 without token)

frontend_payment_method_card.details: Payment Method card section renders on Subscriptions page, shows 'Add Card' when no method, shows card details when method exists

frontend_dialog_opens.details: Clicking 'Add Card' opens PaymentMethodDialog with Stripe Elements CardElement

frontend_dialog_elements.details: Dialog contains: cardholder name input (data-testid='cardholder-name-input'), Stripe CardElement wrapper (data-testid='card-element-wrapper'), security notice, Cancel and Save buttons

frontend_no_errors.details: No runtime errors or crashes on Subscriptions page or when opening dialog

translations.details: Translation keys verified in en.json, es.json, fr.json for all payment method dialog strings
